series.label: Nominal interest paid by the consolidated public sector, % of GDP
series.source_title: Banco Central do Brasil, SGS 5760 - NFSP sem desvalorizacao cambial (% PIB) - Fluxo acumulado em 12 meses - Juros nominais - Total (setor publico consolidado); fetched via IPEA Data BM12_NFSPJNYS12
series.method_notes: December value of the 12-month accumulated flow = calendar-year total, nominal interest accrued (competencia) on domestic and external debt, public sector (non-financial public sector plus Banco Central), without exchange-rate depreciation effect, as % of GDP. Includes real interest and monetary correction. SGS 5760 values were checked identical to IPEA Data BM12_NFSPJNYS12 (http://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/ValoresSerie(SERCODIGO='BM12_NFSPJNYS12')) on 01/12/2002, 01/12/2010, 01/12/2022, 01/03/2025. The series has values only from Nov 2002 (no earlier December value in either source). Current BCB vintage; the Apr 2025 BCB release gave 7.80% for Mar 2025 against 7.77% here (revision).

series.label: Nominal interest paid by the consolidated public sector, R$ bn
series.source_title: IPEA Data BM12_NFSPJNNS12 - NFSP setor publico - juros nominais - sem desvalorizacao cambial (fonte: Banco Central do Brasil, Notas para a Imprensa, Financas Publicas)
series.method_notes: Sum of the 12 monthly flows (R$ million) of each calendar year divided by 1000; only years with all 12 months. Nominal current R$, accrual basis, without exchange-rate depreciation. Cross-check: annual sum divided by annual GDP (BCB SGS 4382, December value) reproduces the % of GDP series to 0.01 pp.

series.label: Bolsa Familia (incl. Auxilio Brasil 2021-22) benefits paid, R$ bn
series.source_title: IPEA Data VAL_PBF12 - Programa Bolsa Familia (PBF) - valor total mensal dos beneficios (fonte: MDS / Portal da Transparencia), Brasil level
series.method_notes: Sum of the 12 monthly benefit totals (R$ thousand, NIVNOME=Brasil) of each calendar year / 1e6. Only full years (series starts Jan 2013). Benefits only, excludes administrative cost; suspended benefits excluded; Auxilio Brasil (2021-2022) counted as the same programme per IPEA note; Auxilio Emergencial 2020 not included. Nominal current R$.

series.label: Bolsa Familia (incl. Auxilio Brasil 2021-22) benefits paid, % of GDP
series.source_title: IPEA Data VAL_PBF12 (MDS) divided by IBGE annual nominal GDP via BCB SGS 4382 (PIB acumulado dos ultimos 12 meses - valores correntes em R$ milhoes)
series.method_notes: Annual benefits (sum of 12 monthly totals, see dist-bolsa-familia-brl-bn, source http://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/ValoresSerie(SERCODIGO='VAL_PBF12')) divided by SGS 4382 value of December of the same year (12-month nominal GDP, R$ million). Computed by us.

series.label: Bolsa Familia (incl. Auxilio Brasil 2021-22): total benefits paid in December of each year, R$ bn per month
series.unit: R$ bn nominal, December month only
series.source_title: IPEA Data VAL_PBF - Programa Bolsa Familia (PBF) - valor total dos beneficios em dezembro (fonte: MDS / Portal da Transparencia), Brasil level
series.method_notes: Value for one month (December) only, not an annual total: R$ thousand / 1e6. Covers 2004 (programme creation) onward, so it fills the years before the annual series starts in 2013. Do not compare in level with the annual R$ bn series (about 12x). Nominal current R$.

series.label: Implicit credit subsidy of Treasury loans to BNDES, R$ bn per year
series.source_title: Tesouro Nacional, Boletim de Subsidios do Tesouro Nacional no ambito do PSI e dos emprestimos ao BNDES, 6o bimestre 2025, Tabela I (column: Valor dos Subsidios Crediticios, Emprestimo da Uniao ao BNDES, valores correntes)
series.method_notes: Valores correntes (nominal) of the annual implicit subsidy = difference between the Treasury funding cost (average issuance cost of DPMFi) and the contractual cost of loans to BNDES, as published by STN/COGEF; position at 31/12/2025. Converted from R$ to R$ bn. PDF: https://cdn.tesouro.gov.br/sistemas-internos/apex/producao/sistemas/thot/arquivos/publicacoes/53784_1733447/Boletim%20de%20Subs%C3%ADdios%20do%20Tesouro%20Nacional%20ao%20BNDES%20e%20a%20FINEP%20-%206%C2%BA%20Bimestre%202025.pdf. Series starts 2008 (first loans). Explicit equalisation subsidies (PSI) are separate and not included.

series.label: Stock of Treasury loans (haveres da Uniao) to BNDES at 31 Dec, R$ bn
series.unit: R$ bn nominal, end of year balance
series.source_title: Tesouro Nacional, Boletim de Subsidios ... BNDES, Tabela V - Haveres da Uniao junto ao BNDES: 6o bimestre 2016 (2015, 2016), 6o bimestre 2020 (2018-2020), 6o bimestre 2022 (2021, 2022), 6o bimestre 2025 (2023-2025)
series.method_notes: Total row of Table V, balance at 31 December, R$ bn nominal. Other bulletin URLs: https://thot-arquivos.tesouro.gov.br/publicacao/25871 (2016), https://thot-arquivos.tesouro.gov.br/publicacao/37108 (2020), https://thot-arquivos.tesouro.gov.br/publicacao/46092 (2022). Values for 2015: 523,859,790,230; 2016: 439,755,026,752; 2018: 306,998,229,433; 2019: 198,946,403,311; 2020: 192,057,966,292; 2021: 123,168,716,297; 2022: 46,398,350,964; 2023: 42,541,835,198; 2024: 40,017,326,062; 2025: 36,202,352,049. Contract coverage differs between bulletins (from 2022 only contracts still outstanding after early repayments are listed; 2016 table is a different contract list); no value found for 2008-2014 and 2017.

series.label: Extreme poverty rate: share of people below PPP$3.00/day (2021 PPP)
series.source_title: IPEA Data PNADS_PERCPOBRE300 - Proporcao de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$3,00 (IPEA, based on IBGE PNAD / PNAD Continua; Souza e Hecksher 2025)
series.method_notes: Share of people with household per capita income below the international line of US$3.00 per day, PPP 2021 (about R$267 per month per capita at 2024 prices, per IPEA). Old PNAD up to 2011 scaled by the factor that matches PNAD Continua in 2012; PNAD Continua from 2012. No survey in 2000 and 2010. Years as published by IPEA.

series.label: Poverty rate: share of people below PPP$8.30/day (2021 PPP)
series.source_title: IPEA Data PNADS_PERCPOBRE830 - Proporcao de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$8,30 (IPEA, based on IBGE PNAD / PNAD Continua; Souza e Hecksher 2025)
series.method_notes: Share of people with household per capita income below US$8.30 per day, PPP 2021 (about R$738 per month per capita at 2024 prices, per IPEA). Same splicing as the extreme-poverty series. This is the IBGE national poverty line used for SDG monitoring (see IPEA PNADCA_TXPNUF note).

series.label: Share of pre-tax national income held by the bottom 50%, Brazil
series.source_title: World Inequality Database (WID.world), Brazil, variable sptinc992j (pre-tax national income share, adults 20+, equal split), percentile p0p50
series.method_notes: File WID_data_BR.csv in the bulk download (zip dated 2026-10-30), variable sptinc992j, percentile p0p50, value x 100. Pre-tax national income, individuals aged 20+, income split equally within couples. Data quality flags in WID vary by year; WID combines household surveys, tax data and national accounts.
